install_banner_text: Install to Home Screen to enable reminders.
onboarding_step1_heading: Add MoodLog to your Home Screen
onboarding_step1_body_ios: Reminders and 7-day data protection only work once MoodLog lives on your Home Screen. Follow the steps below in Safari:
onboarding_step1_ios_step1: Tap the Share icon at the bottom of Safari
onboarding_step1_ios_step3: Open MoodLog from the new icon — setup continues there
onboarding_step1_body_other: Tap the menu, then "Install app". This keeps your entries safe across restarts.
onboarding_step2_body: We'll send one reminder at this time. You can change it later.
onboarding_permission_denied: Reminders are off. You can enable them in your browser settings.
